change.reason: The recovery notes branch bypassed Reader.openContext, so opening the panel did not focus noteInput or record the banner as the close return target.
behavior: Reset only the transient panel selection before navigating to Reader, so Reader captures the current recovery entry even when another panel was already open.
After navigation, use the newly rendered, connected recovery:notes button as the opener passed to the existing readerAction('context:notes', opener).
Open the panel only when Reader navigation succeeds; retain the original missing-document fallback to Library.
Retain existing recovery destinations and the previous coreAction delegation chain.

validation.scope: Original nine modules with R5 fragment edits loaded in assembler order; actual Reader openContext/closeContext and all recovery actions execute against a bounded memory DOM.
limitations: The memory DOM explicitly models banner replacement, focus and connected-element lookup; it is not a browser or a complete DOM implementation.
No real keyboard events, responsive geometry, browser focus trap, remote build, publish, purge or I/O action was exercised.
